entities.name: Avishkar
entities.description: A plane saturated with aether, formerly called Kaladesh, home plane of Chandra Nalaar, where technology does the work magic does elsewhere.

entities.name: Ghirapur
entities.description: The capital of Avishkar, founded on neutral ground after the War of Eleven, a city of invention and aethercraft.

entities.name: The Consulate
entities.description: The governing body of Kaladesh, made up of inventors, that banned pyromancy, grew authoritarian, and was later removed in the Indigo Revolution.

entities.name: Tezzeret
entities.description: A planeswalker who stole Rashmi's matter transporter and turned it into a Planar Bridge, and whose ambitions the Consulate was suspected of serving.

entities.name: Pia Nalaar
entities.description: A renegade leader who was arrested at the Inventors' Fair, later became a consul, and led the defense of the aetherflux reservoir against the Phyrexians.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: A planeswalker native to Kaladesh, arrested as a renegade sympathizer and whose fiery assault disrupted the arena at the Fair.

entities.name: Ajani Goldmane
entities.description: A planeswalker who intervened at the Inventors' Fair with the Gatewatch, freeing prisoners.

entities.name: Gatewatch
entities.description: A team of planeswalkers who confronted Tezzeret at the Fair and later helped the renegades at the Aether Spire.

entities.name: Saheeli Rai
entities.description: A character who met Pia during the defense against the Phyrexian forces.

entities.name: Avaati Vya
entities.description: The person who discovered how to harness aether sixty years before the Great Aether Boom account.

entities.name: Captain Baral
entities.description: A figure who burned down the village of Bunarat.

entities.name: Inventors' Fair
aliases: Grand Exhibition of the Inventors' Fair
entities.description: A month-long festival of innovation in Ghirapur, during which Tezzeret's theft and the arrests exposed the Consulate's authoritarianism.

entities.name: Aether Revolt
entities.description: The rebellion of renegades against the Consulate after the Fair, ending in a confrontation at the Aether Spire.

entities.name: Indigo Revolution
entities.description: A nearly bloodless revolution after the Phyrexian invasion that removed the Consulate and installed the Avishkar Assembly.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The Phyrexian attack on Avishkar for which the reformed Consulate was unprepared.

entities.name: New Culture Collective
entities.description: A countercultural political bloc that helped lead the defense and the Indigo Revolution.

entities.name: Avishkar Assembly
entities.description: The democratic ruling body of representatives from the eleven districts, installed after the Indigo Revolution.

entities.name: The Dhund
entities.description: The Consulate's secret police.

entities.name: The Blind Eternities
entities.description: The space between planes, near whose boundaries Avishkar lies.

entities.name: Aether
entities.description: The energy that saturates Avishkar's atmosphere and powers its technology.

events.summary: Centuries earlier, inventors of the eleven kingdoms negotiate peace after a bloody war; Ghirapur is founded on neutral ground and eleven inventors become the first Consulate.
events.quote: Eleven inventors - one of each kingdom - became the first Consulate .

events.summary: The Great Aether Boom begins as the Mending leaves massive quantities of raw aether available.
events.quote: Since the powers of the Planeswalkers were reduced, there were suddenly massive quantities of raw aether for the taking.

events.summary: At the Inventors' Fair, Tezzeret steals Rashmi's matter transporter to make a Planar Bridge, and Pia and Chandra Nalaar are arrested.
events.quote: The theft of Rashmi's prize-winning matter transporter by Tezzeret , who secretly repurposed it into a Planar Bridge

events.summary: Ajani Goldmane and the Gatewatch free prisoners and confront Tezzeret during the final dueling showcase, igniting open conflict.
events.quote: who freed prisoners and confronted Tezzeret during the final dueling showcase, ignited open conflict.

events.summary: The Consulate seizes the Fair's inventions under the pretext of safekeeping, outraging inventors.
events.quote: the Consulate seized the Fair's inventions under the pretext of “safekeeping,” prompting outrage among inventors.

events.summary: The Consulate declares martial law and militarizes Ghirapur while the Dhund hunts renegade networks.
events.quote: the Consulate declared martial law and transformed the city into a heavily militarized zone.

events.summary: The Gatewatch and renegades confront Tezzeret at the Aether Spire; Pia Nalaar is instated as a consul.
events.quote: Renegade leader Pia Nalaar was instated in a consul's position

events.summary: During the New Phyrexian Invasion, Pia works with artisans to defend the aetherflux reservoir and meets Saheeli Rai, who confirms Phyrexian interest in it.
events.quote: Pia worked with the city's artisans to defend the aetherflux reservoir, which, if breached, would destroy the city.

events.summary: The Indigo Revolution removes the Consulate from power in a nearly bloodless revolution and installs the Avishkar Assembly.
events.quote: The Consulate was removed from power in a nearly bloodless revolution

events.summary: The Omenpaths open and the Assembly establishes embassies and holds the first Ghirapur Grand Prix, a chaotic race across nearly two dozen planes.
events.quote: a widely advertised event called the Ghirapur Grand Prix was held the year that the Omenpaths opened

relations.quote: Avishkar’s gleaming capital of invention and aethercraft

relations.note: Pia is called renegade leader; she works with the renegades
relations.quote: Renegade leader Pia Nalaar was instated in a consul's position
the secret police of the Dhund sought to infiltrate and dismantle the renegade networks.

relations.quote: Pia rendezvoused with Saheeli Rai , who confirmed that the reservoir was drawing the interest of the Phyrexian forces.
